user.title: Connect to Stowaway
user.description: Create a token in the Stowaway dashboard under **Integrations → Home Assistant → API tokens**.

data_description.url: The server's address and the dashboard port (8880 unless you changed it). If you open Stowaway over HTTPS, include https:// and its HTTPS port.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off if Stowaway uses its own (self-signed) certificate

reauth_confirm.title: New Stowaway token needed
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} stopped working (it may have been revoked). Create a new one in the Stowaway dashboard.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Stowaway at that address. Check the address and port.
error.invalid_auth: Stowaway refused the token, or Home Assistant isn't on the same home network as Stowaway.
error.unknown: Stowaway gave an unexpected answer. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Stowaway is already set up.

keep_awake.name: Keep awake
keep_awake.description: Keep an app awake for a while, or until released. Also switches waking back on.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to keep it awake.

forever.name: Until released
forever.description: Keep it awake until the Release action is used.

release.name: Release
release.description: End a keep-awake, so the app can go to sleep when idle.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Put an app to sleep now.

block.name: Don't wake
block.description: Also stop visitors from waking it until it's switched back on.
